about: The anonymous read of one public Twitch channel, as the IRC-over-WebSocket frames src/audience/twitchChat.ts receives. Shapes follow Twitch's IRC wire format (tags, numerics, PRIVMSG, CTCP ACTION, PING, USERNOTICE, CLEARCHAT, USERSTATE); every channel, login, display name, id and line of text is invented. Not a live capture: a live Twitch check is an owner-list item (data-sources C7).
